problems.problem: The cast-concrete render shows two hard formwork seams (one at y≈410 px crossing exactly behind the cap/neck junction, one at y≈1010 px crossing behind the label band). These read as horizon-like lines slicing the silhouette at its weakest points; professional monument compositions keep the plane behind the hero optically continuous so the silhouette stays intact.

Contact detail crop [259,1171,821,1421] confirms a real contact shadow at the base (offset_y 0 is correct, do not move it down), but at opacity 0.35 with blur 10 it is a pale grey smudge narrower than the 402 px base footprint. Against the declared broad soft frontal light it under-anchors a monument-scale bottle; references ground their heroes with a denser, footprint-wide occlusion core.

The upper-left block is correctly asymmetric and non-overlapping (text_product_overlap all false), but logo 30 px / title 64 px / subtitle 24 px sit in three near-equal optical steps with loose vertical gaps, so the block reads as stacked defaults rather than one disciplined editorial unit; the copper line declared in the brief renders as a near-black hairline and the accent #b0762a never appears in the type.

References 3-5 integrate product with environment through matched light wrap, reflection or atmospheric depth. Here the bottle is a clean cut-out on a flat matte plane: edge highlights on the glass do not respond to the cool ambient, and the wall carries no gradient or falloff around the hero, leaving a visible quality gap to the campaign references.

changes.value: Seamless raw cast concrete plane in cool grey, perfectly continuous matte mineral surface with no seams and no joints, very subtle broad vertical luminance falloff from a softly brighter center, even diffuse frontal illumination, empty architectural void
